meta.title: Chalyb — Ready-made AI tools in one place
meta.description: Clip your streams, get crypto signals and run your stream with AI tools. Start free.

hero.h1: Put AI tools to work. Ready in under a minute.
hero.lead: Chalyb brings ready-made AI tools together: clip your streams, get crypto signals and run your stream. Start free.
hero.micro: Free plan · No credit card required · Sign up with Google or email

metrics.4: operating in LATAM and North America

pillars.title: Everything you need to run AI. Nothing you don't.
pillars.subtitle: Three things the platform does well, so you don't have to build any of them.

1.title: Ready-made AI tools, no build required
1.body: Pick from tools the Chalyb team runs in production. Each one solves a specific job from day one.

bullets.1: Clips turns your streams into vertical clips ready to post
bullets.2: Señales tells you when it is a good moment to buy or sell crypto
bullets.3: En vivo runs your stream and your OBS scenes with big buttons

2.title: Test everything free. Go live when you're ready
2.body: Clips is included in the free plan. When you want more, change plans in one click.

bullets.1: Clips included in the free plan
bullets.2: Pro includes one tool of your choice, VIP includes them all
bullets.3: Switch tools or pause any time, no lock-in

3.title: See every run. Pay only for what you use
3.body: History and a credits meter come built in. It is the same tooling the Chalyb team uses on its own systems.

bullets.1: Live dashboards and full execution history
bullets.2: Monthly credits included, top-ups never expire
bullets.3: Secure checkout with Mercado Pago, cancel any time

visuals.modeFoot: One click to switch. No redeploy, no downtime.

how.title: Up and running in three steps
how.subtitle: No sales call, no onboarding project.

1.title: Sign up and connect
1.body: Create your account with Google or email. Your workspace is ready in under a minute.

2.title: Pick a tool
2.body: Choose a tool, connect your channel or paste a link, and you are set.

3.title: Get results
3.body: Clips post themselves, signals arrive in real time and every run is logged. Go live on Pro when it pays.

pricing.title: Start free. Scale when it pays.
pricing.subtitle: No contracts, no sales calls. Pick a plan and you're running in under a minute.
pricing.note: Prices in MXN, VAT (IVA) included. Pro and VIP are charged monthly through Mercado Pago and can be cancelled any time.

welcome.title: Welcome to Chalyb
welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.body: Navigate everything from here, grouped into Your account, Platform and Settings. Switch sections in one click.

engines.title: Your tools
engines.body: Under “Tools” you see and open your tools (Clips, Señales and more). “Included in your plan” = ready to use.

tokens.title: Your credits
tokens.body: Under “Usage” you check how many credits you have left this month. Out of credits? Top up or change plans.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Under “Subscription” you compare Free, Pro and VIP and switch plans. “Billing” has your payments and receipts.

account.title: Your info
account.body: Under “Profile & security” you update your details, change your password and enable two-factor auth.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: “Messages” is a direct line to the Chalyb team, and “Help” has guides and support. We've got you.
